create_ImageFolder_dataset_builder: create an ImageFolder dataset builder from a directory with split/label/image structure
build_ImageFolder_as_dataset: build a tf.data.Dataset from an ImageFolder split with optional file shuffling
load_ImageFolder_example: load and decode an image example from a file path with label and filename

list_image_paths: list supported image file paths from a directory filtering by jpg jpeg png extensions
